Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring notification to parents of mental health treatment options for a minor child.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to notification to parents of the mental healthtreatment options for minors available under chapter 71.34 RCW; andadding a new section to chapter 71.34 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 71.34 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The evaluation and treatment facility is required to promptlyprovide written and verbal notice of all statutorily availabletreatment options contained in this chapter to every parent or guardianof a minor child when the parent or guardian seeks to have his or herminor child treated at an evaluation and treatment facility. (2) The notice must contain the following information: (a) All current statutorily available treatment options includingbut not limited to those provided in this chapter; and (b) The procedures to be followed to utilize the treatment optionsdescribed in this chapter. (3) The department shall produce, and make available, the written p. 1 HB 1612notification that must include, at a minimum, the information containedin subsection (2) of this section.
